title: Weekly Recap
message:
We kept it simple this week: **show up to the river, put fame on the board, take 1st**. **Season 130, Week 1** closes with POAP KINGS at **10,000 fame**, **+20 war trophies**, and an average rank of **1.00**. The cleanest part of the story is the trendline: war momentum is **up**, and we’re turning consistency into trophies. When the rest of the podium is sitting at **0 fame**, the clan that actually plays doesn’t just win — it climbs.

The race was powered by a tight core that treated war like a job (the fun kind). **raquaza** topped the week at **3,050 fame (16 decks)**, **66** was right there with **3,000 fame (14 decks)**, and **Vijay** stacked **2,850 fame (16 decks)**. Then **King Thing (2,700)** and **Chanco (2,300)** made sure the lead stayed uncatchable. That’s the POAP KINGS formula: volume + follow-through + no drama.

Outside war, progression had real teeth. **JaxikoLane** basically hit a growth spurt: **+10 King Levels**, **+1 Path of Legend league**, and a climb to **9,066** (up **+358**). **Chanco** kept moving in the high-trophy air with **+306 best** and **+283 current**, and **Ditaka** stepped up hard with **+1 PoL league** and **+358 current trophies**. Biggest raw ladder surge goes to **shimmeringhost** with **+701 trophies (2,085 → 2,786)** — that’s not a warm-up, that’s an arrival. Also respect to **Vijay** for pushing **+3 PoL leagues** even with a small **-62** trophy dip to land at **12,000**; that’s still elite territory.

The clan economy stayed healthy too: **1,038 donations** on the week, led right now by **JaxikoLane (152)**, **Chanco (134)**, **Vijay (120)**, **King Thing (115)**, and **Ditaka (106)**. And we added fresh blood during the founding-era climb: welcome **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん**, **shimmeringhost**, **stewart**, and **Ditaka** — you joined at the part where we’re building momentum, not reminiscing about it.

Next week is the same win condition with sharper edges: if you can play, **get your war decks used** and keep the river pressure constant — that’s how we turn “upward trend” into a new normal.
